name: Revolut Metal Card
summary: Revolut Metal Card is a premium metal card offering 1% cashback on purchases outside Europe, fee-free ATM withdrawals up to €800/month, and unlimited currency exchanges. Part of the €14.99/month Metal subscription.

kyc.notes: Requirements as published by the provider; confirm during onboarding.

cons: Full KYC, including proof of address, required

faq.question: Does the Revolut Metal Card charge a monthly fee?
faq.answer: Yes — it charges US$14.99 per month. Card issuance is free.

faq.question: What are the foreign-exchange fees on the Revolut Metal Card?
faq.answer: There is no foreign-exchange markup on spending.

faq.question: What KYC does the Revolut Metal Card require?
faq.answer: It requires a government ID plus proof of address.
